documents.title: Opening times
documents.content:
Mon to Thu — 12 til 3, then 5.30 til 10
Fri — 12 til 3, then 5.30 til 11
Sat — 9.30am straight through til 11
Sun — 9.30am til 9.30 (kitchen stops at 9)

kitchen takes last orders half an hour before we close, earlier if it's dead.
closed Christmas Day, Boxing Day and the Tuesday after Easter.
bank holiday mondays we do sunday hours.
if you're not sure just ring, 0161 883 0027, someone's in from about 10.

documents.title: What we do
documents.content:
Lunch and dinner in the restaurant, 34 covers, all downstairs. pasta made fresh most mornings — not the tagliatelle on a Monday, that's Rosa's day off.

Takeaway is phone only, 0161 883 0027. no delivery apps — we tried Deliveroo for four months in 2024 and the food turned up cold. collection about 20 minutes, longer on a friday.

Catering — cold platters, lasagne trays, arancini, tiramisu in the big dish. office lunches mostly, and christenings. minimum 12 people, 4 days notice, a week if it's a saturday. Marco does these, 07892 445 118.

Brunch sat and sun til 2.30. eggs, the sausage plate, ricotta pancakes for the kids.

Set menu for 8 or more, two or three courses, whole table has to be on it.

documents.title: Booking, paying, the rest of it
documents.content:
Bookings
phone or walk in. we hold a table 15 minutes then it goes, saturdays not even that.
6 or more and we take card details when you book. £10 a head if you don't turn up or you cancel on the day. cancel by 12 the day before and there's nothing to pay. under 6, no deposit, just ring and tell us.

Paying
card, cash, apple pay. we'll split a bill 4 ways, not 11 — it holds the whole room up.
10% service on tables of 8 or more, comes straight off if you ask.

Other bits
dogs are fine in the front section, not the back near the pass.
corkage £8 a bottle, wednesdays only.
allergies — tell us when you book, not when you sit down. we won't say a dish is safe over DM, ring and ask for whoever's on the pass.
if something's wrong tell us that night and we'll take it off the bill.

documents.title: Stuff people ask
documents.content:
gluten free? yes, gf pasta, £1.50 extra. the fryer is shared so no gf arancini, sorry.

vegan? a few of the pastas, and vegan cheese goes on any pizza. no vegan pudding at the minute, it's on the list.

kids menu? yes, under 10s. half pasta and a juice.

can I order online? no. phone or come in. people ask this every week, I know.

high chairs? three of them. worth saying when you book on a sunday.

wheelchair? level entry at the front and there's room between the tables. the loos are down a step and they are not accessible, which we're not happy about either — we've had it quoted and it's not happening this year.

big groups? 22 across the two long tables. more than that and we'd be talking about taking the whole place over.

set menu? 8 or more, two or three courses, see the price list.

can I book brunch? saturday yes. sunday is walk-in only, it's chaos otherwise and we've stopped pretending.

half portions for adults? no. kids yes.

is the pasta actually fresh? yes, made most mornings, except monday.

documents.title: How we talk to people
documents.content:
warm but short. we're a 34 cover trattoria, not a call centre.
use their first name if we know them, and we know most of them.
never argue with a review even when they're wrong. say sorry, offer to sort it, give them the phone number.
don't promise anything about allergies over DM. always: ring us and ask for whoever's on the pass.
one exclamation mark is plenty.
a bit of italian is nice, grazie, a presto, but don't lay it on — we're in Chorlton, not Naples.
sign off from Rosa, or from the team when it's not her writing.
